formulas.unit_sum: T_hat=sum_j c_j*t_j; MB_hat=sum_j c_j*MB_j; R_hat=sum_j c_j*R_j
formulas.projection_batches: 1 and 65*N; exactly two projections per round
formulas.large_batch_extrapolation: time and bytes multiplied by target_batch/measured_batch; circuit rounds unchanged

limitations: Loopback on 101; not WAN or production MPC.
Default CrypTen TFP: trusted-provider simulation, not malicious security or measured offline triple provisioning.
Costs include input sharing and output reveals, as in the original benchmark.
Unit-sum estimates omit some local indexing, additions and orchestration; direct validation quantifies the discrepancy.
Memory-limited unit extrapolation assumes linear batch scaling; not a measured full-size round.
No accuracy results read; no manuscript changes.
